purpose: Prove that ECA can support large-project creation, editing, improvement/refactoring and feature addition with quality-preserving bounded context and at least four independent concurrent workstreams.

scope.note: C2 builds and measures the bounded evidence mechanism. Greenfield/new-project and long-horizon claims require later Blueprint/Strategy/Convergence/Verification behavior and are not considered proven by C2 alone.

quality_policy.rule: Do not sacrifice task/oracle correctness, critical-evidence recall, required verification, projection fidelity or truthfulness merely to fit a context target.
quality_policy.insufficient_context_behavior: Expand targeted evidence within the bounded profile when possible; otherwise report the task/profile as not yet supported instead of silently truncating required truth.
quality_policy.comparison: Same-head paired comparison against the best compatible full/current or manual-best condition, with predeclared non-inferiority criteria.

context_targets.definition: Total primary-model context requirement is model-visible prompt/cache context plus reserved output headroom. A 64k-capable claim requires this total to fit within 65536 tokens; input alone being below 64k is insufficient.
context_targets.aspiration: Reduce below these preferred targets when quality is non-inferior. Smaller context is a positive effect, not a goal that overrides correctness.
context_targets.overflow_policy: No correctness-critical truncation. If targeted expansion would exceed the supported profile, mark NOT_64K_CAPABLE for that task class/revision and retain a higher-context fallback outside the 64k claim until repaired.

requirements: four independent task/session identities can remain active without Project Truth, Evidence, plan or workspace cross-contamination
no PI-induced primary-model eviction or reload
no forced reduction of per-task quality/evidence below the accepted bounded-context profile
workspace/revision identity remains exact for every workstream
sidecar/cache/storage behavior remains isolated or safely shared according to explicit keys
parallelism_target.physical_inference_concurrency: Measure four-way simultaneous primary-model inference when the configured backend/runtime supports it. Otherwise record backend scheduler/serialization as an external limit; ECA must not create a competing scheduler merely to satisfy this metric.
parallelism_target.quality_comparison: Each workstream must remain non-inferior to its accepted single-workstream condition. Aggregate throughput alone cannot compensate for a per-task quality failure.

latency_policy.rule: Measure p50/p95 end-to-end and preprocessing/prefill components, but bounded-context and four-workstream feasibility may justify a moderate slowdown. Use the general C2 effect contract to classify large slowdowns as TRADEOFF rather than hiding them.
latency_policy.do_not_ignore: A feature that technically fits 64k/4-way but creates extreme preprocessing, queueing, model reloads or operational fragility is not an automatic default win.

acceptance_progression: C2: prove bounded evidence/context behavior and quality on current sealed/compatible tasks; measure full vs bounded/optimized variants
C3: prove automatic capability/depth selection can preserve the bounded profile on real editing/refactor/feature-addition tasks
V-series: prove required verification and evidence reuse do not force uncontrolled context growth
R0: include realistic large-project lifecycle evidence covering existing-project changes plus a controlled greenfield/new-project workflow before claiming large-project <=64k support
R0/P3 when runtime identities permit: run the four-workstream isolation/resource soak; measure physical four-way inference only when backend supports it

decision_rule.positive_effect: Quality-equivalent context reduction, improved bounded-profile feasibility, or increased safe concurrency is a real PI effect even when final task accuracy is unchanged.
decision_rule.strong_effect: A mechanism or bundle moves a previously unsupported task into the <=65536 total-context profile or enables >=4 safe concurrent workstreams without quality regression.
decision_rule.portfolio: Keep only mechanisms/bundles that contribute marginally or conditionally to quality, bounded-context feasibility, concurrency, verification or meaningful efficiency; otherwise consolidate, default-off, defer or remove according to AGENTS.md.
